originalTitle: Nebius shares soar 22% as AI demand powers revenue beat
simplifiedContent: Nebius, a company that provides artificial intelligence (AI) services through the internet, saw its stock price increase by 22%. This happened because the company made more money than expected, which is a good sign for investors. The reason for this increase in revenue is that more people and companies are using Nebius' services, and they're signing bigger contracts and paying higher prices. As a result, the part of the company's business that focuses on AI services saw a big jump in revenue, which suggests that the company may continue to grow in the future. This is why investors are excited and buying more Nebius shares, causing the price to go up.

originalTitle: Indel Money to raise up to Rs 500 crore via public issue of NCDs
simplifiedContent: Indel Money is planning to raise a large amount of money, up to Rs 500 crore, by issuing special kinds of loans called non-convertible debentures (NCDs) to the public. This means that the company is asking people to lend them money, and in return, they will pay interest on that loan. The process of raising this money will start on August 18 and end on August 31, but it might close earlier if they get enough money. The money they raise will be used for lending to others, paying off existing debts, and other general business purposes. This is important because it shows that Indel Money is trying to grow and expand its business, and it needs money from investors to do so.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the Indian market had a bad day, with many stocks losing value, especially those owned by the Tata Group. This happened because the leader of Tata Sons, N Chandrasekaran, is leaving his job, which made investors nervous. The price of crude oil is also going up, which could lead to higher inflation, making things more expensive for people. As a result, the two main market measures, Sensex and Nifty, fell, but some banks and metal companies did a little better than the rest of the market. This matters because it can affect the value of the stocks you own and the overall direction of the market.

originalTitle: BofA to acquire up to 49.9% stake in Jio Credit for  ₹18,268 crore
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: Bank of America is buying a big part of a company called Jio Credit, which is owned by Jio Financial Services. They're spending up to ₹18,268 crore to buy up to 49.9% of the company. This means Bank of America will own almost half of Jio Credit. The bank is doing this to get more involved in India's growing market, which could be a good opportunity for them. This investment needs to be approved by regulators before it can happen.

originalTitle: IRCTC Q1 Results: Revenue rises 18%, profit remains largely flat at  ₹330 crore
simplifiedContent: IRCTC, a company that runs the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation, recently shared its financial results for the first quarter. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it made, increased by 18% compared to the same time last year, reaching 1,369.53 crore. However, its profit, which is the amount of money it made after expenses, stayed almost the same at 330.16 crore. This is because some parts of the company's business, like tourism, did poorly, while others, like catering, did well. Overall, the company's financial performance was mixed, with some areas growing and others declining.

originalTitle: ‘Successor… not Warren’: Michael Burry says ‘Berkshire is no longer attractive’ over $400 billon cash pile concerns
simplifiedContent: Michael Burry, a well-known investor, thinks that Berkshire Hathaway is no longer a good investment. This is because the company has a huge amount of cash, over $400 billion, that it hasn't been using effectively. Warren Buffett, the company's former leader, is no longer in charge, and the new CEO, Greg Abel, is just starting to use this cash. Burry is concerned that the company's large cash reserve is not being utilized well, which is why he thinks Berkshire Hathaway is not attractive to investors. This matters because Berkshire Hathaway was once a top performer in the market, but its struggles have raised concerns about its future success.
